edits.method: Built-in imagegen with transparent_background=true; alpha preserved in optimized WebP
edits.prompt: Edit type: background-extraction. Edit the supplied direction illustration. Remove only the warm ivory studio background and floor and make them genuinely transparent with alpha. Preserve the existing sculptural subject, exact shape, all thin copper lines, complete object, materials, framing, colors, perspective and highlights. Keep delicate neutral semitransparent contact shadow only immediately below the subject; no opaque floor or rectangular backdrop. Remove ivory background from all open holes and gaps in the object too. Clean precise edges without pale halos. The object must read well when composited over either dark forest green #141a18 or warm off-white #f4f1e9. Do not add objects, text or redesign the subject. Landscape 3:2, maintain the same full composition and margins.
